gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Outdoor Resorts of Chokoloskee is located on the quaint island of Chokoloskee in the elusive Everglades National Park and Ten Thousand Islands. For lodging, we have an eight unit motel each equipped with a kitchenette, two queen beds, flat screen TV with cable, private bathroom, and back deck. We also have two bedroom/two bathroom waterfront condos that overlook Chokoloskee Bay.
